+/**
+ * Integration slot registry tests.
+ *
+ * Proves that a future feature component can be registered without
+ * editing the visualization module's internals (MAP-09 equivalent).
+ *
+ * This is a contract test only — the example component is not a live feature.
+ */
+
+import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
+import type { ComponentType } from 'react'
+import {
+  registerSlot,
+  getSlotComponent,
+  isSlotRegistered,
+  registeredSlots,
+} from '../contexts/SlotRegistry'
+import type { SlotProps, SlotId } from '../contexts/SlotRegistry'
+
+// A minimal stub component — does not implement any feature logic
+const StubComponent: ComponentType<SlotProps> = () => null
+
+describe('SlotRegistry', () => {
+  it('returns null for unregistered slots', () => {
+    expect(getSlotComponent('summaries.context-panel')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('isSlotRegistered returns false before registration', () => {
+    expect(isSlotRegistered('ask.workspace')).toBe(false)
+  })
+})
+
+describe('SlotRegistry: future feature registration', () => {
+  const TEST_SLOT: SlotId = 'summaries.context-panel'
+
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    // Reset: re-import a fresh module or just re-register
+    // (registry is module-level; this test registers over it)
+  })
+
+  it('can register a feature component without editing the map module', () => {
+    // This is the integration contract:
+    // A feature author calls registerSlot() in their module's init file.
+    // They do NOT edit StructureMap.tsx or WorkspaceLayout.tsx.
+    registerSlot(TEST_SLOT, StubComponent)
+
+    expect(isSlotRegistered(TEST_SLOT)).toBe(true)
+    expect(getSlotComponent(TEST_SLOT)).toBe(StubComponent)
+  })
+
+  it('returns registered component from getSlotComponent', () => {
+    registerSlot(TEST_SLOT, StubComponent)
+    const Component = getSlotComponent(TEST_SLOT)
+    expect(Component).not.toBeNull()
+    expect(Component).toBe(StubComponent)
+  })
+
+  it('lists registered slots', () => {
+    registerSlot('ask.workspace', StubComponent)
+    const slots = registeredSlots()
+    expect(slots).toContain('ask.workspace')
+  })
+
+  it('registration does not affect the map source module', () => {
+    // Verify we can import the map without the slot being filled
+    // (the map never imports from feature modules)
+    const mapModule = import('../components/map/StructureMap')
+    expect(mapModule).toBeDefined()
+  })
+})
+
+describe('SlotRegistry: all slot IDs are accepted', () => {
+  const ALL_SLOTS: SlotId[] = [
+    'summaries.context-panel',
+    'dependencies.workspace',
+    'reuse.findings',
+    'duplicates.compare',
+    'unused.review',
+    'ask.workspace',
+    'proposals.detail',
+  ]
+
+  it('accepts all defined slot IDs without throwing', () => {
+    for (const slot of ALL_SLOTS) {
+      expect(() => registerSlot(slot, StubComponent)).not.toThrow()
+    }
+  })
+})
